item.title: Ask for a Paper Form
item.prompt_text: You want to sign up for an exercise class. The desk has a square code to scan, but you do not have your phone. Ask for a paper form and ask where to bring it when you finish.
item.target_grammar: Can I for a request and where for a destination.
item.fluency_objective: Say the problem in one short sentence, then ask two separate questions. Listen back and check the two requests.
item.pronunciation_objective: Stress paper form and where. Let each question finish before starting the next one.
item.model_answer: Hello. I'd like to sign up for the class. I don't have my phone with me. Can I have a paper form, please? Where should I bring it when I finish?
